note: People born in Guam are citizens of the United States (8 U.S.C. 1407(b)), and Guam is part of the United States for the nationality law (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38)), so its rules are the United States'.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1407 Persons living in and born in Guam
sources.said: (b) All persons born in the island of Guam on or after April 11, 1899 (whether before or after August 1, 1950) subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are declared to be citizens of the United States

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1101 Definitions
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island. ... (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
